title: How many Safe Deposit Boxes may one customer hold or reserve?
content:
## Scope

This policy governs how many rentals in the Safe Deposit Boxes line a single customer may hold, and it applies when a new reservation for a box is to be recorded. A customer may rent more than one box, subject to the limits below.

## Policy clause

1. Before a new reservation is recorded, the number of the customer's rentals that are waitlisted, active, past due or drill pending must be below 3.
2. The number of the customer's rentals of the requested size must be below the per-size limit in the table, and that per-size count includes reservations.
3. The number of the customer's open reservations, meaning rentals still in waitlisted status, must be below the reservation limit in the table.
4. A customer who has any rental in drill pending status cannot reserve another box.

The counts are taken from the bank's own rental records for that customer, as they stand before the new reservation is recorded; the customer's own account of what they hold is not the basis. A closed rental is not one of the statuses counted.

## Limits by box size

| Official box size | Most rentals of this size per customer, reservations included | Most open reservations per customer |
|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | 2 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | 2 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | 2 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 |

Across all sizes together, the limit on waitlisted, active, past due and drill pending rentals is 3 per customer.

## Checklist before a reservation is recorded

| Check | Counted from the bank's records | Must be |
|---|---|---|
| Any rental in drill pending status | Customer's rentals | None |
| All open rentals (waitlisted, active, past due, drill pending) | Customer's rentals, every size | Below 3 |
| Rentals of the requested size, reservations included | Customer's rentals of that size | Below the per-size limit |
| Open reservations (waitlisted) | Customer's rentals, every size | Below the reservation limit |

## Hypothetical cases

The holdings below are invented for illustration only.

- **Case 1.** The customer has an active 3x5 box and a waitlisted 10x10 reservation, and asks to reserve a 10x10 box. All open rentals: 2, below 3. Rentals of the 10x10 size: 1, which is not below the 10x10 limit of 1. The reservation cannot be recorded.
- **Case 2.** The customer has an active 3x5 box and a closed 5x10 rental, and asks to reserve another 3x5 box. The closed rental is not counted. All open rentals: 1. Rentals of the 3x5 size: 1, below 2. Open reservations: 0. No rental is drill pending. None of the limits in this policy is exceeded.
- **Case 3.** The customer has two waitlisted reservations, one for a 3x5 and one for a 3x10, and asks to reserve a 5x10. All open rentals: 2, below 3. Rentals of the 5x10 size: 0. Open reservations: 2, which is not below 2. The reservation cannot be recorded.
- **Case 4.** The customer's only rental is drill pending. Although the count of open rentals is 1, the customer cannot reserve another box.

## Points of judgement

**Does a waitlisted reservation count toward the per-size limit?** Yes. The per-size count includes reservations.

**Does "below 3" allow a third open rental?** A customer holding 2 open rentals is below 3, so this overall limit does not prevent a third reservation; a customer already holding 3 is not below 3, and the overall limit prevents a fourth.
